label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from HTTP Referer header flows directly to unsanitized HTML output via response.getWriter().printf() with format string insertion. URL decoding provides no XSS protection and the printf sink renders the decoded value directly into response body without escaping.

evidence.note: Referer header captured, URL decoded, passed through doSomething(), then written to response via printf with format string causing XSS
